section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes one unnamed study (Study X) that tested whether body image flexibility mediates the relationship between body dissatisfaction and body appreciation in a college-bound sample of 84 White older adolescent females. Participants self-reported height and weight (BMI calculated) and completed the BI-AAQ and the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS); analyses found partial mediation by body image flexibility with effects retained when controlling for BMI.
